summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of Pebbles Brand Identity 8-slide animated presentation. All features working correctly: preview route loads without errors, public route shows email gate, all 8 slides render with data-testid attributes, navigation (buttons + keyboard arrows) works, frosted glass nav with Pebbles icon and slide counter visible, left progress dots visible, pink progress bar at bottom, dark/light backgrounds alternate correctly.

Public route /proposals/pebbles-brand loads with email gate - PASS
Email gate shows 'Pebbles — Brand Identity & Vision' subtitle - PASS
All 8 slides render with data-testid pebbles-slide-1 through pebbles-slide-8 - PASS
Frosted glass nav bar visible with Pebbles icon and 'Pebbles' text - PASS
Slide counter shows correct format 'XX / 08' - PASS
Left progress dots visible on desktop (lg:flex) - PASS
Bottom progress bar (pink) visible - PASS
Prev/Next navigation buttons work - PASS
Prev button has opacity 0.2 on slide 1 (properly disabled) - PASS
Keyboard ArrowRight/ArrowLeft navigation works - PASS
Slide 1: Pebbles logo visible, tagline text, 'BRAND IDENTITY & VISION' pink label - PASS
Slide 2: Pink accent bar on left, 'WHY PEBBLES?' title, pink icon on right, pink tint quote strip at bottom - PASS
Slide 3: Dark background, 'ROOTED IN SCRIPTURE' title, three scripture entries (Luke 19:40, Joshua 4:6-7, Luke 10:7) with pink dots - PASS
Slide 4: 'THE ICON' title, 'THREE MEANINGS IN ONE MARK', three cards (Coins/STACKED PAY, Food/BENEFITS, Pebbles/THE NAME) with pink numbered circles - PASS
Slide 5: Dark background, 'THE COLOR' title, 'WHY PINK?' subtitle, four reasons with pink dots, pink color swatch (#FF2D8A) in bottom-right - PASS
Slide 6: 'WHAT PEBBLES DOES' with 'HIGH LEVEL' subtitle, two cards - light (For Employers) and dark (For Employees) - PASS
Slide 7: Dark background, 'THE VISION' with 'WHERE WE'RE GOING' subtitle, four numbered vision points (01-04) with pink numbers - PASS
Slide 8: Dark background closing slide with white Pebbles icon, 'Pebbles' text, pink tagline 'Your salary, in pieces you control.' - PASS
Card on /proposals page links to /proposals/pebbles-brand with pink branding - PASS
Card displays '8 Slides • Brand Book' and 'NEW' badge - PASS
Dark/light backgrounds alternate correctly: dark-light-dark-light-dark-light-dark-dark - PASS
critical_code_review_comments: All data is hardcoded in component as expected - no API calls needed
Good use of data-testid attributes for all 8 slides and navigation elements
Framer-motion animations working correctly for scroll-triggered reveals
Keyboard navigation properly implemented with ArrowLeft/ArrowRight/ArrowUp/ArrowDown
Color palette correctly applied: Pink #FF2D8A, Dark #0D0D0D, White #FFFFFF
Logo files correctly referenced from /logos/pebbles/ directory
